inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev25 GMX retail no-op/topology evidence, GUI baseline, mod-package, workspace, native-builder, research, extraction and source-only gates are inherited. Dev26 adds opt-in whole MESH/ARRY graph synchronization without modifying dev25.

proven_regression: new complete MESH/ARRY graph with fresh identities
dev26_gmx_mesh_graph_sync.inherited_external_retail_gate: dev25 306/306 mesh-bearing GMX no-op byte-identical plus plr_001 topology smoke
dev26_gmx_mesh_graph_sync.boundary: New mesh nodes clone a compatible native vertex declaration. New BONE/PARE/MTRL/SHAD nodes and from-scratch GMX construction remain unresolved.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no missing/mismatched/unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, then passed 72/72 selftests and version checks. The final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and is revalidated separately.

limitations: Dev26 whole-mesh graph synthesis is structurally regression-tested but has not yet been exercised as a new arbitrary multi-object model on retail hardware/emulator.
Synthesized MESH/ARRY nodes clone a compatible native layout; arbitrary vertex-declaration synthesis is not implemented.
New BONE/PARE/MTRL/SHAD graph nodes are not synthesized; only existing BONE mesh attachments can be repaired/retargeted.
The external dev25 retail 306/306 no-op and plr_001 topology evidence is inherited rather than re-bundled or re-run from proprietary inputs in this release tree.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
Audio replacement/rebuilding remains intentionally deferred by current project priority.
